note: Divergent Association Task style items: 7 unrelated single nouns. Score = mean pairwise cosine distance of the word embeddings, after validity filtering (single word, no proper nouns, no repeats).

items.prompt: 请给出 7 个彼此尽量没有关联的常见名词。要求：每个都是单个词（不要写成句子）、不要专有名词、不要重复；每条想法只输出一个名词。
请给出 10 个彼此尽量没有关联的常见名词。要求：每个都是单个词（不要写成句子）、不要专有名词、不要重复；每条想法只输出一个名词。

Please give 7 common nouns that are as unrelated to each other as possible. Conditions: each one must be a single English word (no sentences), no proper nouns, no repeats; output one noun per idea. This is the English wording of the Divergent Association Task (Olson et al., 2021), so results can be compared with the published human sample.
